preservedLogic: Original ink too shiny or flat.
Introduce physically based shading to improve realism.
Raised-ink dark shading obscures two-team boundary.
Remove shading: lose wall/floor shape cues.
Increase specular: lose enemy submerge splash cues.
Adjust material for simultaneous visibility of gameplay information.

thesis: Ink shading carries team-color boundaries, geometric shape and enemy-submerge information; adjusting shade and specular visibility preserves those separate signals.

rendererDecision.noNewShaderImplementationClaim: Our shader is a controlled teaching model. Values, formulas and render results do not recover Nintendo code.
rendererDecision.modelDetails: Original direct-light GGX teaching shader with artistic shade/specular controls, raised geometry, two ink colors, neutral articulated diver and deterministic ring/droplets; no Nintendo formula or copied asset. Shade A/B:1→0 with specular0.3. Specular A/B:0.3→3.5 with shade0.55. Roughness0.23, light/camera/geometry/phase fixed within each comparison. Values are our parameters, not game measurements.
